name: Hızlı Okuma YÖKDİL-Sağlık (60-70)
words: PARA-SAGLIK-60-70-001
According to the paragraph, what can walking every day do?

Walking every day is [good] for the [heart].
{Although} it seems [simple], this [habit] can {lower} the [risk] of many [diseases].
[Doctors], (who work with older patients), [say] that people who stay active often feel happier.
{However}, too much exercise without [rest] may {harm} the [body].

Lower the risk of many diseases
Harm the body without rest
Make simple habits difficult
Help only older patients

Doğru cevap: 'Lower the risk of many diseases'. {Although} it seems simple + {lower} the risk zinciri, yürüyüşün hastalık riskini DÜŞÜRDÜĞÜNÜ söyler. 'Harm the body' aslında son cümledeki {However} + too much exercise tarafına aittir, yürüyüşe değil → tuzak. {} kelimelerini (Although/However) atlarsan bu iki tarafı karıştırıp yanlış şıkka kayarsın. (who work with older patients) → () süs bilgi, okumana gerek yok; 'only older patients' oradan yapılan yanlış çıkarımdır.
Dentists advise replacing an old toothbrush every three months.
PARA-SAGLIK-60-70-002
According to the paragraph, what does fast food do?

Eating fruits and vegetables [helps] the body [fight illness].
{Because} they contain [vitamins], doctors [recommend] them every day.
Fast food, (which is cheap and quick), can {increase} the [risk] of [weight gain] and [heart problems].
{However}, small [changes] in your [diet] can {improve} your [health] over time.

It increases the risk of weight gain and heart problems
It helps the body fight illness
It provides many vitamins
It improves health over time

Doğru cevap: fast food riski ARTIRIR. Fast food ... can {increase} the risk zinciri buna bağlıdır. 'Fight illness' ve 'vitamins' meyve-sebze cümlesine aittir → tuzak. 'Improve health' ise diyet değişikliği cümlesine ait. (which is cheap and quick) → () süs bilgidir. {Because}/{However} gibi {} kelimeleri hangi ifadenin hangi tarafta olduğunu gösterir; onları takip edince tuzak şıklar elenir.
Most adults need around eight hours of sleep every night.
PARA-SAGLIK-60-70-003
According to the paragraph, what can reduce stress?

[Stress] is a normal part of [life], {but} too much of it can {harm} your [health].
When people feel worried, their [body] produces a [hormone] called cortisol.
[Experts], (who study the brain), [found] that [deep breathing] can {reduce} this [stress].
{Although} it sounds [simple], this [method] really [works].

Deep breathing
Producing more cortisol
Feeling worried more often
Raising the stress hormone

Doğru cevap: 'Deep breathing'. [Experts] ... [found] that deep breathing can {reduce} this stress → {reduce} yön fiili, stresi AZALTAN şeyi işaret eder. Cortisol stresle GELEN hormondur; onu artırmak çözüm değil → tuzak. {but}/{Although} kelimeleri cümlenin yönünü verir. (who study the brain) süs bilgidir, atlanır.
Regular dental visits catch small cavities before they grow larger.
PARA-SAGLIK-60-70-004
According to the paragraph, why is plain water the best choice?

Drinking enough [water] is [necessary] for a healthy [body].
{Because} we lose water all day, we must [drink] more, especially in hot [weather].
Sugary drinks do {not} [replace] water well and can {increase} [thirst].
{So}, plain water, (which has no sugar or calories), [remains] the [best] [choice].

Sugary drinks do not replace water well and increase thirst
Sugary drinks replace water better than plain water
We do not lose water during the day
Hot weather reduces our need for water

Doğru cevap: şekerli içecekler suyun yerini iyi TUTMAZ ve susuzluğu ARTIRIR. do {not} [replace] + {increase} [thirst] zinciri bunu söyler. 2. şık {not}'u atlayanın düşeceği tuzaktır — olumsuzluğu ({}) kaçırırsan anlamı tam TERSİNE çevirirsin. {Because} su kaybını, {So} sonucu bağlar. (which has no sugar or calories) → () süs bilgidir, atlanabilir.
Gentle morning stretches prepare tired muscles for a long day.
PARA-SAGLIK-60-70-005
According to the studies, what does quitting smoking do?

Smoking is one of the most [dangerous] [habits] for the [lungs].
{Although} many smokers know the [risks], they find it hard to [stop].
[Studies], (which followed people for years), [show] that quitting can {improve} [health] after a long time.
{However}, the [damage] is {not} always [reversible], {so} starting early is [risky].

It can improve health even after a long time
It always reverses all the damage
It makes stopping easy
It increases the risk to the lungs

Doğru cevap: bırakmak uzun süre sonra bile sağlığı İYİLEŞTİREBİLİR. [Studies] ... [show] that quitting can {improve} health → {improve} yön fiili. 2. şık tuzak: paragraf 'the damage is {not} always reversible' der, yani 'her zaman geri döndürür' YANLIŞ — {not} olumsuzluğunu kaçıranın hatası. (which followed people for years) süstür. {Although}/{However} tarafları ayırır.
Fresh vegetables give people many important vitamins and minerals.
PARA-SAGLIK-60-70-006
According to the paragraph, what happens if you do not dry your hands?

Washing your [hands] often is a [simple] way to [stay healthy].
{Because} germs spread through [touch], clean hands can {prevent} many [infections].
Soap, (which most homes already have), can {remove} more [germs] than water alone.
{However}, if you {do not} [dry] your hands, germs can still [spread].

Germs can still spread
Soap removes all the germs
Infections are always prevented
Hands stay completely clean

Doğru cevap: elleri kurulamazsan mikroplar yine YAYILIR. {However} + {do not} [dry] zinciri bu şartı kurar. Diğer şıklar 'her şey temizlenir/önlenir' diyerek olumsuzluğu ({do not}) ve {However} zıtlığını görmezden gelir → tuzak. (which most homes already have) süs bilgidir. {Because} mikropların dokunmayla yayıldığını açıklar.
A short evening walk helps many people relax after work.
PARA-SAGLIK-60-70-007
According to the paragraph, why may many children not sleep well?

Good [sleep] helps [children] [grow] and [learn].
{Because} the brain is [active] at night, sleep [supports] [memory].
Many children use [phones] before bed, {so} they may {not} sleep [well].
Doctors, (who see this often), [suggest] a quiet [routine].

They use phones before bed
Their brain is not active at night
They follow a quiet routine
Sleep supports their memory

Doğru cevap: yatmadan önce telefon kullandıkları için. 'use phones before bed, {so} they may {not} sleep well' → {so} sonucu, {not} olumsuzluğu bu ilişkiyi kurar. Şık 3 (quiet routine) çözümdür, sebep değil → tuzak. {} kelimelerini (so/not) takip edersen sebep-sonuç yönünü şaşırmazsın. (who see this often) süstür.
Breakfast with eggs gives the brain steady energy for hours.
PARA-SAGLIK-60-70-008
According to the paragraph, what do doctors suggest?

Too much [sugar] can {harm} your [teeth] and [health].
{Although} sweet foods taste [good], they give [energy] that does {not} last [long].
Sugary drinks, (which are popular with children), can {increase} the [risk] of [weight gain].
{So}, doctors [suggest] [fruit] {instead of} [candy].

Eating fruit instead of candy
Drinking more sugary drinks
Getting energy from sweet foods
Eating candy for long-lasting energy

Doğru cevap: şeker yerine meyve. {So} doctors suggest fruit {instead of} candy → {instead of} 'X değil Y' seçimini kurar. Şık 4 tuzak: paragraf tatlıların enerjisi does {not} last long der, yani 'uzun süren enerji' YANLIŞ. {} kelimelerini (not/instead of) kaçıran ters şıkka kayar. (which are popular with children) süstür.
Swimming twice a week builds strong muscles at any age.
PARA-SAGLIK-60-70-009
According to the paragraph, what is true about social media?

Spending [time] with [friends] is [good] for [mental health].
{Because} people are social, [loneliness] can {increase} [stress] and [sadness].
Social media, (which connects millions), does {not} always [replace] real [friendship].
{However}, a short [talk] with a friend can {improve} your [mood].

It does not always replace real friendship
It always replaces real friendship
It increases loneliness for everyone
It reduces the need for friends

Doğru cevap: sosyal medya gerçek arkadaşlığın yerini HER ZAMAN TUTMAZ. does {not} always [replace] → {not} olumsuzluğu belirleyicidir. Şık 2 tam tersini söyler; {not}'u atlayan bu tuzağa düşer — olumsuzluk ({}) kaçınca anlam TERSİNE döner. (which connects millions) süs bilgidir. {Because}/{However} tarafları ayırır.
Cooked meals should go into the fridge within two hours.
PARA-SAGLIK-60-70-010
According to the paragraph, what can too much sun do?

A little [sunlight] every day is [healthy] for the [body].
{Because} the skin makes [vitamin D] from the sun, short walks can {improve} [bone health].
Too much sun, (which feels warm and nice), can {harm} the [skin] {though}.
{So}, doctors [suggest] sun in the [morning] {rather than} at [noon].

Harm the skin
Improve bone health
Make more vitamin D safely
Stay warm and healthy for the body

Doğru cevap: fazla güneş cildi ZARAR verebilir. 'Too much sun ... can {harm} the skin {though}' → {harm} yön fiili + {though} zıtlığı bunu kurar. 'Improve bone health' az güneşe / kısa yürüyüşe aittir → tuzak. (which feels warm and nice) süstür; cazip görünmesi tuzağı besler. {rather than} sabahı öğlene tercih ettirir.
Drinking enough water keeps the mind fresh during lessons.
PARA-SAGLIK-60-70-011
According to the paragraph, why do vaccines help?

[Vaccines] [protect] people from many [diseases].
{Because} they teach the body to [fight] [germs], they can {prevent} serious [illness].
Some people, (who fear needles), [avoid] them, {but} the [risk] of [disease] is much [higher].
{So}, doctors [recommend] vaccines for [children].

They teach the body to fight germs and prevent illness
They make the risk of disease higher
They are only for people who fear needles
They spread serious illness

Doğru cevap: vücuda mikroplarla savaşmayı öğretip ciddi hastalığı ÖNLERLER. {Because} they teach the body to fight germs + {prevent} illness zinciri. Şık 2 tuzak: 'risk is higher' aşı OLMAYAN taraf için söylenir ({but} tarafı), aşının kendisi için değil. (who fear needles) süstür. {but}/{So} kelimelerini takip edince tuzaklar elenir.
Sitting with a straight back reduces pressure on the spine.
PARA-SAGLIK-60-70-012
According to the paragraph, what happens if you never rest your eyes?

Looking at [screens] for hours can [tire] your [eyes].
{Because} we [blink] less in front of a [screen], our eyes get [dry].
Short [breaks], (which take only a minute), can {reduce} this [problem].
{However}, if you {never} [rest] your eyes, the [strain] gets [worse].

The strain gets worse
The eyes stop getting dry
You start to blink more often
Short breaks become longer

Doğru cevap: gözleri hiç dinlendirmezsen zorlanma ARTAR. '{However}, if you {never} [rest] your eyes, the strain gets worse' → {However} zıtlığı + {never} olumsuzluğu bu şartı kurar. Diğer şıklar olumlu ifadeleri ters yerde kullanır. {} kelimelerini (However/never) kaçıran yanlış şıkka kayar. (which take only a minute) süstür.
Whole grain bread contains more fiber than white bread.
PARA-SAGLIK-60-70-013
According to the paragraph, what can brushing too hard do?

Brushing your [teeth] twice a day is very [important] for [health].
{Because} sugar helps [bacteria] grow, sweet foods can {cause} [cavities].
Dentists, (who see many patients), [recommend] brushing after meals.
{However}, brushing too hard can {damage} the [gums].

Damage the gums
Prevent all cavities
Help bacteria grow
Replace meals

Doğru cevap: çok sert fırçalamak diş etlerine ZARAR verir. '{However}, brushing too hard can {damage} the gums' → {However} zıtlığı + {damage} yön fiili bunu kurar. Diğer şıklar olumlu ifadeleri (prevent cavities, help bacteria) yanlış yerde kullanır. Taktik: '{However} + too + sıfat/zarf' kalıbı neredeyse hep olumsuz bir sonuç getirir; ters-anlam kelimesini ({}) kaçırma. (who see many patients) süs bilgidir.
Morning walks in fresh air lift the mood for hours.
PARA-SAGLIK-60-70-014
According to the paragraph, what happens without enough calcium?

Strong [bones] need a mineral called [calcium].
{Because} milk and cheese are [rich] in calcium, they {strengthen} the [body].
[Sunlight], (which the skin uses), also [supports] bone health.
{Without} enough calcium, bones can become [weak].

Bones can become weak
Bones become stronger
The skin stops using sunlight
Milk loses its minerals

Doğru cevap: yeterli kalsiyum OLMAZSA kemikler zayıflar. '{Without} enough calcium, bones can become weak' → {Without} yokluğu + 'weak' olumsuz sonucu kurar. Şık 2 tam tersi; olumsuzluğu ({Without}) kaçıran bu tuzağa düşer. Taktik: 'without enough ___' kalıbı daima olumsuz bir sonuç getirir. (which the skin uses) süstür.
Washing hands before meals stops many germs from spreading.
PARA-SAGLIK-60-70-015
According to the paragraph, what is a healthier choice?

Eating too much fast food can {lead} to [obesity].
{Because} these meals are [high] in fat and sugar, they add many [calories].
Some drinks, (which taste sweet), also {increase} the [risk].
{However}, cooking at [home] is a [healthier] choice.

Cooking at home
Eating more fast food
Drinking sweet drinks
Adding more calories

Doğru cevap: evde yemek pişirmek. '{However}, cooking at home is a healthier choice' → {However} zıtlığı, fast food'un olumsuzlarından SAĞLIKLI seçeneğe geçişi kurar. Diğer şıklar paragrafın olumsuz taraflarını (fast food, sweet drinks, calories) çözümmüş gibi gösterir → tuzak. Taktik: '{However} + healthier/better' kalıbı çözüm cümlesidir. (which taste sweet) süstür.
Loud music through headphones can slowly harm young ears.
PARA-SAGLIK-60-70-016
According to the paragraph, why do doctors advise eating less salt?

Too much [salt] is [bad] for the [heart].
{Because} it {raises} [blood pressure], doctors [advise] eating less of it.
Processed foods, (which are very common), often contain [hidden] salt.
{Therefore}, reading food [labels] is a [useful] habit.

Because it raises blood pressure
Because it lowers blood pressure
Because it is hidden in labels
Because processed foods are rare

Doğru cevap: tuz kan basıncını YÜKSELTTİĞİ için. '{Because} it {raises} blood pressure' → {Because} sebebi, {raises} yön fiili bunu verir. Şık 2 tersini (lowers) söyler → yön fiilini ({raises}) kaçıranın tuzağı. Taktik: neden sorusunda cevap çoğunlukla '{Because}' cümleciğinde saklıdır. (which are very common) süstür.
A quiet dark room helps people fall asleep faster.
PARA-SAGLIK-60-70-017
According to the paragraph, what should you do if a fever is very high?

A [fever] is the body's natural way to [fight] infection.
{Because} rest helps the body [recover], doctors [suggest] staying in bed.
Cold drinks, (which feel nice), do {not} [cure] the illness.
{However}, if a fever is very [high], you should see a [doctor].

See a doctor
Only drink cold drinks
Ignore it completely
Stop resting

Doğru cevap: ateş çok yüksekse doktora görün. '{However}, if a fever is very high, you should see a doctor' → {However} + koşul cümlesi bu istisnayı kurar. 'cold drinks do {not} cure' olduğu için şık 2 tuzaktır. Taktik: '{However} + if very ___' bir istisna/uyarı getirir; olumsuzluğu ({not}) kaçırma. (which feel nice) süstür.
Dentists warn that hard brushing can wear down enamel.
PARA-SAGLIK-60-70-018
According to the paragraph, why are fruits and vegetables good for weight control?

Fruits and vegetables give the body many [vitamins].
{Because} they are [low] in fat, they [help] with weight [control].
{Although} canned food is [easy], fresh food (which spoils faster) has more [vitamins].
{So}, eating [colorful] meals keeps us [healthy].

Because they are low in fat
Because they are high in fat
Because they spoil quickly
Because they are canned

Doğru cevap: yağ oranı DÜŞÜK olduğu için. '{Because} they are low in fat, they help with weight control' → {Because} sebebi verir. Şık 2 tersi (high) → tuzak. Taktik: 'low in fat / high in ___' gibi zıt niteliklerde doğru olanı cümlenin olumlu akışından seç. (which spoils faster) süstür; {Although} taze-konserve zıtlığını kurar.
A brisk daily walk strengthens the heart and legs.
PARA-SAGLIK-60-70-019
According to the paragraph, what can even a short walk do?

Sitting for many hours is [harmful] to the [body].
{Because} it slows [blood flow], it can {cause} back [pain].
Doctors, (who study this), [advise] moving every hour.
{However}, even a short [walk] can [improve] [circulation].

Improve circulation
Slow blood flow
Cause back pain
Increase sitting hours

Doğru cevap: kısa bir yürüyüş bile dolaşımı İYİLEŞTİRİR. '{However}, even a short walk can improve circulation' → {However} olumsuz (oturmak) tablodan olumluya geçişi kurar. Şık 2-3 oturmanın olumsuz sonuçları → yanlış yerde. Taktik: '{However} + even ___' küçük bir çabanın olumlu etkisini vurgular. (who study this) süstür.
Beans and lentils offer cheap protein for family meals.
PARA-SAGLIK-60-70-020
According to the paragraph, why should we use antibiotics carefully?

Antibiotics are [strong] medicines that [kill] [bacteria].
{However}, they do {not} work against [viruses] like the common cold.
Doctors, (who know this well), [warn] against using them too often.
{Because} overuse makes bacteria [resistant], we should use them [carefully].

Because overuse makes bacteria resistant
Because they kill viruses
Because they cure colds
Because doctors never use them

Doğru cevap: aşırı kullanım bakterileri DİRENÇLİ yaptığı için. '{Because} overuse makes bacteria resistant' → {Because} sebebi verir. Şık 2-3 tuzak: paragraf 'do {not} work against viruses/colds' der, yani virüse/soğuk algınlığına ETKİSİZ. Olumsuzluğu ({not}) kaçıran yanılır. Taktik: neden sorusu → '{Because}' cümleciğine bak. (who know this well) süstür.
Short morning sunlight helps the skin make vitamin D.
PARA-SAGLIK-60-70-021
According to the paragraph, what can too much heat be?

Spending time [outdoors] is good for both body and [mind].
{Because} fresh air {increases} [oxygen], it helps us feel more [awake].
Sunlight, (which we need in small amounts), also lifts our [mood].
{However}, too much [heat] can be [dangerous].

Dangerous
Good for the mood
A source of oxygen
Always helpful

Doğru cevap: fazla sıcak TEHLİKELİ olabilir. '{However}, too much heat can be dangerous' → {However} olumlu tablodan (fresh air, sunlight) olumsuza dönüşü kurar. Diğer şıklar olumluları yanlış yere taşır. Taktik: '{However} + too much ___' neredeyse hep olumsuz sonuç getirir. (which we need in small amounts) süstür.
Flossing once a day cleans the spaces between teeth.
PARA-SAGLIK-60-70-022
According to the paragraph, what is the best source of protein?

The body needs [protein] to build and repair [muscles].
{Because} meat, eggs, and beans are [rich] in protein, athletes eat them often.
{Although} pills are [easy], a balanced diet (which includes many foods) is [better].
{Therefore}, natural food is the [best] [source].

Natural food
Pills
Only meat
Muscles

Doğru cevap: doğal besin. '{Therefore}, natural food is the best source' → {Therefore} önceki bilgilerden sonucu çıkarır; '{Although} pills are easy ... is better' zaten hapları eler. Taktik: '{Although} X easy, Y better' kalıbı Y'yi (doğal besin) öne çıkarır. (which includes many foods) süstür.
Regular eye tests catch vision problems at an early stage.
PARA-SAGLIK-60-70-023
According to the paragraph, what can eating too much fiber too fast cause?

[Fiber] is an important part of a [healthy] diet.
{Because} it helps [digestion], it prevents [constipation].
Whole grains, (which are cheap), contain a lot of fiber.
{However}, eating too much too fast can {cause} [discomfort].

Discomfort
Better digestion
Cheaper grains
Less fiber

Doğru cevap: (aşırı ve hızlı lif) rahatsızlık YARATABİLİR. '{However}, eating too much too fast can {cause} discomfort' → {However} zıtlığı + {cause} yön fiili. Şık 2 olumluyu (better digestion) yanlış yere koyar. Taktik: '{However} + too much too fast' aşırılığın olumsuz sonucunu verir. (which are cheap) süstür.
Sunscreen protects the skin from harmful rays in summer.
PARA-SAGLIK-60-70-024
According to the paragraph, what is true about the medicines?

In spring, many people suffer from [allergies].
{Because} pollen fills the [air], they sneeze and their eyes get [red].
Medicines, (which a doctor can suggest), often {reduce} the [symptoms].
{However}, they do {not} [remove] the cause.

They reduce the symptoms but do not remove the cause
They remove the cause completely
They cause allergies
They fill the air with pollen

Doğru cevap: ilaçlar belirtileri azaltır ama nedeni ORTADAN KALDIRMAZ. '{reduce} the symptoms' + '{However} ... do {not} remove the cause' → {However} + {not} bu sınırı çizer. Şık 2 tam tersi; olumsuzluğu ({not}) kaçıran yanılır. Taktik: '{reduce} ... {However} not remove' = 'hafifletir ama çözmez', sık çıkan bir tuzaktır. (which a doctor can suggest) süstür.
Cold water after exercise cools the body down quickly.
PARA-SAGLIK-60-70-025
According to the paragraph, what does meditation need in order to work?

Meditation is a simple way to [calm] the [mind].
{Because} slow breathing {lowers} the heart [rate], it reduces [stress].
Just ten [minutes] a day, (which anyone can find), can [help].
{However}, it needs regular [practice] to [work].

Regular practice
A fast heart rate
More than an hour a day
No breathing

Doğru cevap: düzenli pratik. '{However}, it needs regular practice to work' → {However} 'kolay ama şartı var' anlamını kurar. Diğer şıklar paragrafla çelişir (yavaş nefes, on dakika). Taktik: '{However} + it needs ___ to work' bir ÖN KOŞUL bildirir. (which anyone can find) süstür.
Fresh fruit at breakfast adds natural sweetness without extra sugar.
PARA-SAGLIK-60-70-026
According to the paragraph, when are headphones safe?

Loud [noise] can slowly {damage} our [hearing].
{Because} the ears are very [sensitive], long concerts can be [harmful].
Headphones, (which many young people use), are safe at [low] volume.
{However}, listening too [loudly] can {cause} lasting [problems].

At low volume
At high volume
During long concerts
When used all day

Doğru cevap: düşük ses seviyesinde. 'Headphones ... are safe at low volume' bunu doğrudan söyler; '{However}, listening too loudly can {cause} lasting problems' zıttını (yüksek ses) eler. Taktik: 'safe at ___' + '{However} too loudly' karşıtlığı; {However}'ı takip edince tuzak (high volume) belli olur. (which many young people use) süstür.
Students who eat breakfast usually focus better during morning lessons.
PARA-SAGLIK-60-70-027
According to the paragraph, what cannot even the best chair do?

Sitting with a straight [back] protects the [spine].
{Because} bad posture puts [pressure] on the muscles, it can {cause} [pain].
Office workers, (who sit for hours), should use a good [chair].
{However}, even the best chair cannot [help] {without} regular [movement].

Help without regular movement
Protect the spine completely
Cause back pain
Replace office workers

Doğru cevap: düzenli hareket OLMADAN en iyi sandalye bile yardımcı olamaz. '{However}, even the best chair cannot help {without} regular movement' → {However} + {without} bu sınırı çizer. Şık 2 abartılı olumlu (completely) → tuzak. Taktik: '{However} + even the best ... cannot' bir istisna/sınır bildirir; olumsuzluğu ({without}) kaçırma. (who sit for hours) süstür.
Flu vaccines are offered in many clinics every autumn.
PARA-SAGLIK-60-70-028
According to the paragraph, what do doctors advise?

The sun gives us [energy], {but} its rays can {harm} the [skin].

Diğer şıklar olumlu/ilgisiz (balance, eyesight) → metinle çelişir. Taktik: 'while' iki zıt durumu yan yana koyar (sabit sayfa ↔ hareket); çatışma cevabın kalbidir. (which resets the senses) süstür.
Hard candies between meals bathe the teeth in sugar.
PARA-SAGLIK-60-70-112
According to the paragraph, why is warming up before sport important?

Jumping straight into hard [sport] risks [injury].
{Because} cold muscles are [stiff] and tear [easily], a warm-up {prepares} them.
Five minutes of light [movement], (which many skip), raises muscle [temperature].
{Therefore}, a short warm-up {prevents} many [problems].

Because cold stiff muscles tear easily
Because warm muscles tear more
Because warming up causes injury
Because skipping it is safer

Doğru cevap: soğuk ve sert kaslar kolay YIRTILDIĞI için. '{Because} cold muscles are stiff and tear easily, a warm-up {prepares} them' → {Because} cümlesi. Şık 2-4 tam ters iddialar (ısınma sakatlar, atlamak güvenli). Taktik: metnin mantığı 'ısınma korur' iken tersini söyleyen tüm şıklar elenir; {prevents} yön fiili yönü teyit eder. (which many skip) süstür.
A water bottle on the desk reminds us to drink.
PARA-SAGLIK-60-70-113
According to the paragraph, what role does fiber play in digestion?

A diet rich in [fiber] keeps digestion [smooth].
{Because} fiber holds [water] and adds [bulk], it helps waste move [easily].
Whole grains and beans, (which are cheap sources), also keep us [full].
{However}, adding too much too fast can {cause} [bloating].

It holds water and helps waste move easily
It dries out the digestive system
It makes us hungry sooner
It should be added as fast as possible

Doğru cevap: su tutar ve atığın kolay ilerlemesine YARDIM eder. '{Because} fiber holds water and adds bulk, it helps waste move easily' → {Because} cümlesi. Şık 2 tam tersi (dries out); şık 4 '{However} ... too fast can {cause} bloating' ile çelişir. Taktik: {However} cümlesi bir uyarı verir ('yavaş ekle'); 'as fast as possible' diyen şık bu uyarının tersidir. (which are cheap sources) süstür.
Short silent breaks give the ears rest after loud lessons.
PARA-SAGLIK-60-70-114
According to the paragraph, why is standing up during long flights advised?

Sitting still for many [hours] on a flight slows [blood] in the [legs].
{Because} slow blood can form dangerous [clots], doctors {advise} standing up sometimes.
A short walk in the [aisle], (which feels awkward), keeps blood [moving].
{Therefore}, small movements protect [health] on long trips.

Because slow blood can form dangerous clots
Because standing up forms clots
Because blood moves faster when still
Because walking is dangerous on flights

Doğru cevap: yavaş kan tehlikeli PIHTI oluşturabildiği için. '{Because} slow blood can form dangerous clots, doctors {advise} standing up' → {Because} + {advise}. Şık 2-4 ilişkiyi ters çevirir (ayağa kalkmak pıhtı yapmaz, korur). Taktik: {advise} edilen davranış çözümdür; onu tehlikeymiş gibi gösteren şık tuzaktır. (which feels awkward) süstür.
Fresh orange juice adds vitamin C to the morning meal.
PARA-SAGLIK-60-70-115
According to the paragraph, what is true about sugar-free drinks?

Sugar-free [drinks] seem like a perfect [choice].
{However}, some contain [acids] that can still {harm} tooth [enamel].
Water, (which has no acid or sugar), stays the [safest] option.
{Therefore}, 'sugar-free' does {not} always mean [harmless].

'Sugar-free' does not always mean harmless
'Sugar-free' means completely safe
Water harms the enamel most
Acids protect the teeth

Doğru cevap: 'şekersiz' her zaman ZARARSIZ demek DEĞİLDİR. '{However}, some contain acids that can still {harm} enamel' + '{Therefore}, does {not} always mean harmless' → {However} + {not}. Şık 2 paragrafın çürüttüğü inanış → tuzak. Taktik: 'seem like perfect {However}' kalıbında doğru cevap {However} tarafındadır; 'not always' ölçülü ifadesini 'completely' ile değiştiren şık yanlıştır. (which has no acid or sugar) süstür.
Strong stomach and back muscles keep the spine well supported.
PARA-SAGLIK-60-70-116
According to the paragraph, why does stress affect the stomach?

Strong [stress] does not stay in the [mind] alone.
{Because} the brain and [gut] are closely [linked], worry can {cause} stomach [pain].
Calming habits like slow [breathing], (which anyone can try), often ease both.
{Therefore}, treating the mind can also help the [body].

Because the brain and gut are closely linked
Because the stomach ignores the brain
Because stress only affects the mind
Because breathing harms the stomach

Doğru cevap: beyin ve bağırsak yakından BAĞLI olduğu için. '{Because} the brain and gut are closely linked, worry can {cause} stomach pain' → {Because} + {cause}. Şık 2-3 bu bağı reddeder (ilk cümle 'not in the mind alone' der). Taktik: 'not ... alone' açılışı 'sadece orada değil' der; 'only affects the mind' diyen şık tam tersidir. (which anyone can try) süstür.
Childhood vaccines have removed several deadly diseases from many countries.
PARA-SAGLIK-60-70-117
According to the paragraph, why is warm-up important before swimming?

Cold water can [shock] the body at [first].
{Because} sudden cold {tightens} the [muscles], jumping in fast is [risky].
Entering slowly, (which lets the body adjust), keeps swimmers [safe].
{Therefore}, a short warm-up matters even in the [pool].

Because sudden cold tightens the muscles
Because warm water shocks the body
Because slow entry is dangerous
Because swimmers never warm up

Doğru cevap: ani soğuk kasları KASTIĞI için. '{Because} sudden cold {tightens} the muscles, jumping in fast is risky' → {Because} + {tightens}. Şık 3 tam tersi: yavaş girmek GÜVENLİdir. Taktik: '{Therefore}' cümlesi ('warm-up matters') doğru davranışı özetler; onu tehlike gibi gösteren şık elenir. (which lets the body adjust) süstür.
Bananas offer quick natural energy before a busy morning.
PARA-SAGLIK-60-70-118
According to the paragraph, what do bright screens at night do to sleep?

Bright [screens] at night trick the [brain].
{Because} blue light looks like [daylight], it {delays} the sleep [hormone].
Reading a paper book, (which gives off no light), is [gentler].
{Therefore}, dimming screens an hour before bed {improves} [sleep].

Blue light delays the sleep hormone
Blue light speeds up sleep
Screens have no effect on sleep
Daylight ruins paper books

Doğru cevap: mavi ışık uyku hormonunu GECİKTİRİR. '{Because} blue light looks like daylight, it {delays} the sleep hormone' → {Because} + {delays}. Şık 2 yön fiilinin tersi (delays ↔ speeds up). Taktik: {delays} 'geciktirir' demek; 'speeds up' diyen şık tam zıttıdır, yön fiilini kaçırma. (which gives off no light) süstür.
Regular towel washing removes germs that build up unseen.
PARA-SAGLIK-60-70-119
According to the paragraph, why should cuts be kept clean and covered?

An open [cut] is a door for [germs].
{Because} bacteria enter through broken [skin], keeping it clean {prevents} [infection].
A simple [bandage], (which any first-aid box has), also stops [dirt].
{However}, a red swollen wound needs a [doctor].

Because bacteria enter through broken skin
Because germs avoid open cuts
Because bandages create infection
Because clean cuts attract dirt

Doğru cevap: bakteriler kırık deriden GİRDİĞİ için. '{Because} bacteria enter through broken skin, keeping it clean {prevents} infection' → {Because} + {prevents}. Şık 2-4 saçma ters iddialar. Taktik: {Because} cümlesindeki mekanizma nettir; onu tersine çeviren (avoid/create/attract) şıklar elenir. (which any first-aid box has) süstür.
Grilled meals carry less fat than deep fried dishes.
PARA-SAGLIK-60-70-120
According to the paragraph, what makes tea a gentler source of caffeine than coffee?

Both [tea] and coffee contain [caffeine].
{Because} tea releases it more [slowly], its effect feels [smoother].
A cup in the [afternoon], (which suits many people), rarely ruins night [sleep].
{However}, very strong tea can still keep some awake.

Tea releases caffeine more slowly
Tea has no caffeine at all
Coffee releases caffeine slowly
Tea always ruins sleep

Doğru cevap: çay kafeini daha YAVAŞ saldığı için. '{Because} tea releases it more slowly, its effect feels smoother' → {Because} cümlesi. Şık 3 yavaşlığı KAHVEYE yükler → karıştırma tuzağı; şık 4, 'rarely ruins' ile çelişir. Taktik: 'rarely' yarı-olumsuz; onu görmeyen 'always ruins' tuzağına düşer. (which suits many people) süstür.
Shoulder rolls at the desk loosen tight upper muscles.
PARA-SAGLIK-60-70-121
According to the paragraph, why do our eyes need blinking breaks at screens?

Staring at a [screen] makes us blink [less].
{Because} fewer blinks leave the eyes [dry], long sessions cause [irritation].
The 20-20-20 rule, (which is easy to remember), gives the eyes short [rest].
{Therefore}, blinking often {protects} eye [comfort].

Because fewer blinks leave the eyes dry
Because blinking dries the eyes
Because screens increase blinking
Because dry eyes feel comfortable

Doğru cevap: az kırpışma gözleri KURU bıraktığı için. '{Because} fewer blinks leave the eyes dry, long sessions cause irritation' → {Because} zinciri. Şık 2-3 ilişkiyi ters çevirir (ekran kırpışmayı AZALTIR, artırmaz). Taktik: 'less/fewer' azlık bildirir; 'increase' diyen şık tam tersidir. (which is easy to remember) süstür.
Steamed vegetables keep more vitamins than boiled ones.
PARA-SAGLIK-60-70-122
According to the paragraph, what is the safest way to lose belly fat?

Many ads, (which flood social media), promise to burn belly [fat] in [days].
{However}, the body cannot choose where it loses [fat] first.
{Because} overall exercise and [diet] shape the whole body, spot [tricks] fail.
{Therefore}, patience and balance beat any quick [promise].

Overall exercise and diet, with patience
Special tricks for the belly only
Burning fat in a few days
Exercising just one body part

Doğru cevap: genel egzersiz ve beslenme, sabırla. '{Because} overall exercise and diet shape the whole body, spot tricks fail' → {Because} cümlesi. Şık 2-4 'spot reduction' inanışıdır; metin '{However}, the body cannot choose where' ile bunu çürütür. Taktik: 'promise ... {However} cannot' kalıbında reklam vaadi yanlış, {However} sonrası doğrudur. (which flood social media) süstür.
Seven to nine hours of sleep suit most adult bodies.
PARA-SAGLIK-60-70-123
According to the paragraph, why is breakfast called the most important meal for students?

Students who eat [breakfast] focus better at [school].
{Because} the brain runs on [glucose] from food, an empty stomach {lowers} [concentration].
A simple meal, (which takes minutes), fuels the whole [morning].
{Therefore}, skipping it can hurt [grades].

Because an empty stomach lowers concentration
Because the brain needs no glucose
Because breakfast tires students
Because skipping it improves focus

Doğru cevap: boş mide dikkati DÜŞÜRDÜĞÜ için. '{Because} the brain runs on glucose..., an empty stomach {lowers} concentration' → {Because} + {lowers}. Şık 4 tam tersi (skipping improves) → {lowers} yönünü kaçıranın tuzağı. Taktik: 'empty stomach {lowers}' ile 'skipping improves' zıttır; yön fiilini takip et. (which takes minutes) süstür.
Light evening showers help tired muscles relax before bed.
PARA-SAGLIK-60-70-124
According to the paragraph, what does drinking water before meals help with?

Drinking a glass of [water] before [meals] can help [digestion].
{Because} it fills part of the [stomach], we often eat a little [less].
This small [habit], (which costs nothing), supports weight [control].
{However}, drinking too much during eating can {slow} [digestion].

It helps us eat a little less
It makes us eat much more
It always slows digestion
It replaces meals completely

Doğru cevap: biraz daha AZ yememize yardım eder. '{Because} it fills part of the stomach, we often eat a little less' → {Because} cümlesi. Şık 3 tuzak: yavaşlatan şey öğün SIRASINDA çok su içmektir ({However} tarafı), öncesinde değil. Taktik: 'before meals' ile 'during eating' zamanlarını ayır; {However} farklı bir durumu anlatır. (which costs nothing) süstür.
Cotton swabs pushed deep can damage the inner ear.
PARA-SAGLIK-60-70-125
According to the paragraph, why is a balanced routine better than extreme health plans?

People often start [extreme] health [plans] full of energy.
{Because} strict rules are hard to [keep], most give up within [weeks].
A gentle balanced [routine], (which fits real life), lasts far [longer].
{Therefore}, small steady habits beat short intense [efforts].

Because strict rules are hard to keep long-term
Because extreme plans are easy to follow
Because balance is impossible
Because giving up is the goal

Doğru cevap: katı kuralları uzun vadede SÜRDÜRMEK zor olduğu için. '{Because} strict rules are hard to keep, most give up within weeks' → {Because} cümlesi. Şık 2 tam tersi ('hard' ↔ 'easy'). Taktik: '{Therefore}, small steady habits beat short intense efforts' metnin ana fikri; ölçülü olanı öven sonuç cümlesine güven. (which fits real life) süstür.
Daily tooth brushing works best with a two minute timer.

name: Hızlı Okuma YÖKDİL-Fen (60-70)
words: According to the paragraph, why do plants need sunlight?

Plants make their own [food] using [sunlight].
{Because} light powers a process called [photosynthesis], leaves turn energy into [sugar].
Without enough light, (which happens in deep shade), plants grow [weak].
{Therefore}, most plants lean toward the nearest [window].

Because sunlight powers photosynthesis to make food
Because sunlight cools the leaves
Because plants eat soil directly
Because shade makes plants stronger

Doğru cevap: güneş ışığı fotosentezi ÇALIŞTIRIP besin ürettiği için. '{Because} light powers photosynthesis, leaves turn energy into sugar' → {Because} cümlesi. Şık 4 'shade makes stronger', metnin 'grow weak' ile tersi. Taktik: fen paragrafında süreç adı (photosynthesis) + {Because} genelde 'neden' sorusunun cevabıdır. (which happens in deep shade) süstür.
Volcanoes release hot gases and ash high into the sky.
According to the paragraph, what happens to water when it is heated enough?

Water can exist as [solid], liquid, or [gas].
{Because} heat gives molecules more [energy], warming ice first melts it, then {turns} it to [steam].
Cooling, (which removes energy), reverses the [process].
{Therefore}, temperature decides water's [state].

Heat turns it into steam
Heat freezes it faster
Heat has no effect on water
Cooling turns it to gas

Doğru cevap: yeterli ısı onu BUHARA çevirir. '{Because} heat gives molecules more energy, warming ... {turns} it to steam' → {Because} + {turns}. Şık 4 tuzak: gaza çeviren ISITMADIR, soğutma değil — yön karıştırma. Taktik: 'heat/cool' zıt çiftinde hangi sonucun hangisine ait olduğunu eşleştir. (which removes energy) süstür.
Magnets attract iron nails through a thin sheet of paper.
According to the paragraph, why does a heavy ship float?

It seems strange that a heavy metal [ship] can [float].
{Because} the ship's shape pushes aside a lot of [water], the water pushes back with an upward [force].
This force, (which we call buoyancy), holds the ship [up].
{However}, a hole that lets water in can {sink} it.

The pushed-aside water creates an upward force
Metal is lighter than water
The ship has no weight
Water has no force at all

Doğru cevap: itilen su YUKARI doğru kuvvet yaratır. '{Because} the ship's shape pushes aside a lot of water, the water pushes back with an upward force' → {Because} zinciri. Şık 2-4 fizikle çelişir. Taktik: 'seems strange {Because} ...' kalıbında {Because} cümlesi paradoksu çözer; onu oku, sezgiye kapılma. (which we call buoyancy) süstür.
Bees carry yellow pollen from one flower to another.
According to the paragraph, what causes day and night?

Day and [night] follow each other in a steady [rhythm].
{Because} the Earth {spins} on its [axis], each side faces the [Sun] in turn.
This daily turn, (which takes 24 hours), never [stops].
{Therefore}, sunrise simply means our side is turning toward the [light].

The Earth spinning on its axis
The Sun moving around the Earth
The Earth stopping at night
Clouds blocking the Sun

Doğru cevap: Dünya'nın kendi ekseninde DÖNMESİ. '{Because} the Earth {spins} on its axis, each side faces the Sun in turn' → {Because} + {spins}. Şık 2 yaygın yanlış inanış (Güneş döner) → metinle çelişir. Taktik: fen sorularında 'yaygın yanlış' şık cazip olur; {Because} cümlesindeki gerçek mekanizmaya bak. (which takes 24 hours) süstür.
Roots pull water and minerals from the deep soil below.
According to the paragraph, why do we see lightning before we hear thunder?

During a storm, [lightning] and [thunder], (which are born together), happen at the same [moment].
{However}, we see the flash [first].
{Because} light travels much [faster] than [sound], the flash reaches our eyes before the noise reaches our [ears].
{So}, counting the gap tells us how far the storm [is].

Because light travels faster than sound
Because thunder happens after lightning
Because sound travels faster than light
Because our ears are slower to wake

Doğru cevap: ışık sesten daha HIZLI yayıldığı için. '{Because} light travels much faster than sound, the flash reaches our eyes before the noise' → {Because} cümlesi. Şık 3 tam tersi (sound faster) → yön çevirme tuzağı. Taktik: '{However}, we see first' + {Because} birlikte cevabı verir; şık 2 aynı anı ('same moment') görmezden gelir. (yok)
Green leaves make food using energy from the bright sun.
According to the paragraph, what makes magnets attract certain metals?

A [magnet] pulls some metals but not [others].
{Because} iron and steel have a special [structure], they respond to the magnetic [force].
Materials like wood or plastic, (which lack this structure), feel [nothing].
{Therefore}, a magnet sorts metals from [non-metals] quickly.

Iron and steel have a structure that responds to the force
All materials react to magnets
Wood is strongly magnetic
Magnets pull everything equally

Doğru cevap: demir ve çeliğin kuvvete tepki veren özel bir YAPISI olduğu için. '{Because} iron and steel have a special structure, they respond to the magnetic force' → {Because} cümlesi. Şık 2-4 'all/everything' genellemeleri metnin 'some but not others' ayrımıyla çelişir. Taktik: 'some ... not others' ayrımını 'all/everything' ile ezen şıklar tuzaktır. (which lack this structure) süstür.
Rainbows appear when sunlight passes through falling drops of rain.
According to the paragraph, why is the ozone layer important?

High above us, a thin [layer] of ozone protects [life].
{Because} it {blocks} much of the Sun's harmful [rays], it acts like a natural [shield].
Damage to this layer, (which pollution can cause), lets more radiation [through].
{Therefore}, protecting the ozone protects our [skin] and eyes.

It blocks harmful rays like a shield
It produces harmful rays
It has no effect on radiation
It makes the Sun hotter

Doğru cevap: Güneş'in zararlı ışınlarını ENGELLEDİĞİ için. '{Because} it {blocks} much of the Sun's harmful rays, it acts like a natural shield' → {Because} + {blocks}. Şık 2 yön fiilinin tersi (blocks ↔ produces). Taktik: 'shield/protect' kelimeleri 'engelleme' yönünü doğrular; 'produces harmful' diyen şık zıttır. (which pollution can cause) süstür.
A compass needle always turns to point toward the north.
According to the paragraph, what does the water cycle do?

Water on Earth is never truly [lost].
{Because} the Sun {evaporates} water from [seas], it rises, forms [clouds], and falls again as [rain].
This endless loop, (which we call the water cycle), keeps rivers [full].
{Therefore}, today's rain may be yesterday's [sea].

It moves the same water between sea, clouds and rain
It creates brand-new water each time
It removes water from Earth forever
It stops when it rains

Doğru cevap: aynı suyu deniz, bulut ve yağmur arasında DOLAŞTIRIR. '{Because} the Sun {evaporates} water from seas, it rises, forms clouds, and falls again' → döngü açık. Şık 2-3 ilk cümlenin ('never truly lost') tersi. Taktik: 'never lost / endless loop' ifadeleri döngüyü anlatır; 'new water / removes forever' diyen şıklar bunu bozar. (which we call the water cycle) süstür.
Spiders spin silk threads stronger than steel of equal weight.
According to the paragraph, why do metals feel colder than wood?

Touching [metal] feels colder than touching [wood], even in the same [room].
{Because} metal {carries} heat away from our hand [quickly], it makes the skin feel [cold].
Wood, (which is a poor conductor), moves heat [slowly].
{Therefore}, the feeling is about heat flow, not real [temperature].

Metal carries heat away from the hand quickly
Metal is actually colder than wood
Wood carries heat faster than metal
The room is colder near metal

Doğru cevap: metal ısıyı elden hızla UZAKLAŞTIRDIĞI için. '{Because} metal {carries} heat away from our hand quickly, it makes the skin feel cold' → {Because} + {carries}. Şık 2 metnin '{Therefore}, about heat flow, not real temperature' vurgusuyla çelişir. Taktik: metin 'gerçek sıcaklık değil, hissedilen' der; 'actually colder' diyen şık bu ayrımı kaçırır. (which is a poor conductor) süstür.
The Moon circles the Earth once about every four weeks.
According to the paragraph, why do we recycle paper?

Making new [paper] uses many [trees] and much [water].
{Because} recycling reuses old [fibers], it {saves} both forests and [energy].
Recycled paper, (which looks almost the same), works for most daily [needs].
{Therefore}, sorting waste is a small act with a big [effect].

Because recycling reuses fibers and saves resources
Because new paper uses no trees
Because recycling wastes more energy
Because old paper cannot be used again

Doğru cevap: geri dönüşüm lifleri yeniden kullanıp kaynak TASARRUF ettiği için. '{Because} recycling reuses old fibers, it {saves} both forests and energy' → {Because} + {saves}. Şık 3-4 tam tersi iddialar. Taktik: {saves} yön fiili 'kazanç' bildirir; 'wastes more / cannot be used' diyen şıklar zıttır. (which looks almost the same) süstür.
Bats find insects in the dark by listening to echoes.
According to the paragraph, what makes the Moon shine at night?

The [Moon], (which orbits the Earth), seems to glow with its own [light].
{However}, it makes no light at [all].
{Because} its surface {reflects} [sunlight] toward Earth, we see it [bright].
{Therefore}, a full moon is simply the side fully lit by the [Sun].

It reflects sunlight toward Earth
It produces its own light
It blocks the Sun completely
It burns like a small star

Doğru cevap: yüzeyi güneş ışığını Dünya'ya YANSITTIĞI için. '{However}, it makes no light at all. {Because} its surface {reflects} sunlight' → {However} + {Because}. Şık 2 metnin çürüttüğü inanış ('seems ... {However} makes no light'). Taktik: 'seems ... {However}' kalıbında görünen yanlış, {However} sonrası doğrudur. (yok)
Salt spread on icy roads helps melt the frozen surface.
According to the paragraph, why does salt melt ice on roads?

In winter, cities spread [salt] on icy [roads].
{Because} salt {lowers} the freezing [point] of water, ice melts even below zero [degrees].
The melted [water], (which would refreeze in pure form), stays liquid with salt in [it].
{Therefore}, salt keeps roads [safer].

Because salt lowers water's freezing point
Because salt makes water colder
Because salt heats the road
Because ice never melts with salt

Doğru cevap: tuz suyun donma NOKTASINI düşürdüğü için. '{Because} salt {lowers} the freezing point of water, ice melts even below zero' → {Because} + {lowers}. Şık 3 yanlış mekanizma (tuz yolu ısıtmaz). Taktik: '{lowers} the freezing point' teknik ifadedir; 'heats' gibi sezgisel ama yanlış şıklar elenir. (which would refreeze in pure form) süstür.
Honey can stay fresh in a jar for many years.
According to the paragraph, why do bees matter for farming?

Tiny [bees] do a huge job for [farmers].
{Because} they carry [pollen] from flower to [flower], they help plants make [fruit].
Without this pollination, (which happens as bees feed), many crops would [fail].
{Therefore}, protecting bees protects our [food].

Because they carry pollen and help plants make fruit
Because they eat harmful crops
Because they replace farmers
Because flowers need no pollen

Doğru cevap: çiçekten çiçeğe polen taşıyıp bitkinin meyve yapmasına YARDIM ettikleri için. '{Because} they carry pollen from flower to flower, they help plants make fruit' → {Because} cümlesi. Şık 4 metnin 'without pollination crops fail' vurgusuyla çelişir. Taktik: 'without X, Y fails' yapısı X'in (polen) hayatiliğini gösterir; 'need no X' diyen şık zıttır. (which happens as bees feed) süstür.
A thermometer's liquid rises higher as the day grows warmer.
According to the paragraph, why does the Earth attract objects?

[Gravity] pulls everything toward the [ground].
{Because} the Earth has a huge [mass], it {attracts} smaller objects like [apples] and people.
A dropped [pen], (which we see fall daily), proves this [force].
{However}, far out in space, this pull grows [weak].

Leave a metal [spoon] in hot [soup] and its handle turns [hot].
{Because} metal [carries] heat quickly from one end to the [other], the heat travels up the [handle].
A wooden [spoon], (which conducts poorly), stays [cool].
{Therefore}, cooks often prefer wooden [handles].

Metal carries heat quickly along its length
The soup climbs up the handle
Wood carries heat faster than metal
The handle makes its own heat

Doğru cevap: metal ısıyı bir uçtan diğerine hızla TAŞIDIĞI için. '{Because} metal carries heat quickly from one end to the other, the heat travels up the handle' → {Because} cümlesi. Şık 3 tam tersi (wood faster). Taktik: 'metal fast / wood poor' zıt çifti; ahşap serin kalır. (which conducts poorly) süstür.
A seed waits quietly in dry ground until the rain returns.
According to the paragraph, why is it easier to float in the sea?

It is easier to [float] in the [sea] than in a [pool].
{Because} salty water is [denser] than fresh water, it pushes up on us more [strongly].
The very salty Dead [Sea], (which almost no fish call home), lets people float like [corks].
{Therefore}, salt changes how well we [float].

Salty water is denser and pushes up more strongly
Sea water is lighter than pool water
Pools contain far more salt
Salt makes swimmers heavier

Doğru cevap: tuzlu su daha YOĞUN olup bizi daha güçlü ittiği için. '{Because} salty water is denser than fresh water, it pushes up on us more strongly' → {Because} cümlesi. Şık 2 tam tersi (lighter). Taktik: 'denser → more push → float'; 'lighter/heavier' zıt. (which almost no fish call home) süstür.
A fresh apple slowly browns after a knife opens its skin.
According to the paragraph, what lifts a bird into the air?

A heavy [bird] can rise into the [air] with ease.
{Because} air moves faster over the curved top of a [wing], it creates an upward [lift].
Flapping, (which pushes air down), adds even more [force].
{Therefore}, wing shape is the secret of [flight].

Faster air over the curved wing creates upward lift
The bird becomes lighter than the air
Air simply pushes the wing downward
The feathers block all the wind

Doğru cevap: kanadın kavisli üstünden hızlı geçen hava YUKARI kaldırma yaratır. '{Because} air moves faster over the curved top of a wing, it creates an upward lift' → {Because} cümlesi. Diğer şıklar yanlış. Taktik: 'wing shape → lift'; '{Therefore}, secret of flight'. (which pushes air down) süstür.
A calm lake mirrors the clouds until a gentle wind ripples it.
According to the paragraph, why can soap wash away grease that water cannot?

Plain [water] alone cannot wash away [grease].
{Because} soap grabs both [oil] and [water] at once, it lifts grease off the [dish].
The dirty [water], (which carries the grease away), then rinses [off].
{Therefore}, soap is the bridge between oil and [water].

Soap grabs both oil and water at once
Soap turns the grease into water
Water strongly dislikes soap
Grease dissolves easily in plain water

Doğru cevap: sabun hem yağı hem suyu aynı anda TUTTUĞU için. '{Because} soap grabs both oil and water at once, it lifts grease off the dish' → {Because} cümlesi. Şık 4 metnin 'water alone cannot' ile çelişir. Taktik: '{Therefore}, bridge between oil and water' ana fikir. (which carries the grease away) süstür.
A honeybee dances to guide the hive toward nearby blossoms.
According to the paragraph, why does the body shiver in the cold?

When we get very [cold], the body starts to [shiver].
{Because} fast muscle [movements] produce [heat], shivering warms us from [inside].
Warm [clothes], (which trap body heat), reduce the [need].
{Therefore}, shivering is the body's own [heater].

Fast muscle movements produce heat
Shivering cools the body down more
Cold muscles simply stop moving
Warm clothes are what cause shivering

Doğru cevap: hızlı kas hareketleri ISI ürettiği için. '{Because} fast muscle movements produce heat, shivering warms us from inside' → {Because} cümlesi. Şık 2 tam tersi (cools). Taktik: '{Therefore}, body's own heater' ana fikir; titreme ısıtır. (which trap body heat) süstür.
A tall tree lifts water from its roots to high branches.
According to the paragraph, how do fish breathe underwater?

[Fish] live underwater without ever coming up to [breathe].
{Because} their [gills] pull [oxygen] straight out of the [water], they never need open [air].
Out of water, (which their gills cannot use), a fish quickly [suffocates].
{Therefore}, gills are perfectly built for a wet [life].

Their gills pull oxygen out of the water
They gulp air at the surface all day
They hold their breath for many days
They make their own oxygen inside

Doğru cevap: solungaçları oksijeni sudan ÇEKTİĞİ için. '{Because} their gills pull oxygen straight out of the water, they never need open air' → {Because} cümlesi. Şık 2 metnin 'without ever coming up' ile çelişir. Taktik: solungaç = sudan oksijen; '{Therefore}, built for wet life'. (which their gills cannot use) süstür.
A gear turns a second gear and passes motion along a chain.
According to the paragraph, why does bread go stale?

Fresh [bread] slowly goes hard and [stale].
{Because} the bread loses [moisture] to the dry [air], its soft crumb turns [firm].
A sealed [bag], (which keeps moisture in), slows this [change].
{Therefore}, open bread stales faster than wrapped [bread].

It loses moisture to the dry air
It soaks up water from the air
A sealed bag speeds up staling
Bread stays soft and fresh forever

Doğru cevap: NEMİNİ kuru havaya kaptırdığı için. '{Because} the bread loses moisture to the dry air, its soft crumb turns firm' → {Because} cümlesi. Şık 2 tam tersi (soaks up); şık 3 metnin 'sealed bag slows' ile çelişir. Taktik: 'loses moisture → stale'; kapalı torba yavaşlatır. (which keeps moisture in) süstür.
A coral reef shelters countless small fish beneath the warm sea.
According to the paragraph, why does the Moon look bigger near the horizon?

The [Moon] looks huge when it sits near the [horizon].
{However}, it has not changed [size] at all.
{Because} our brain compares it to trees and buildings, (which sit near the horizon), it only seems [bigger].
{Therefore}, the giant moon is a trick of the [mind], not the [sky].

Our brain compares it to nearby objects
The Moon truly grows at the horizon
The Moon moves much closer to Earth
The horizon magnifies the light

Doğru cevap: beynimiz onu yakındaki nesnelerle KIYASLADIĞI için. '{Because} our brain compares it to trees and buildings, it only seems bigger' → {Because} cümlesi. Şık 2-3 metnin 'not changed size' ile çelişir. Taktik: 'seems ... {However} not changed' yanılsama; '{Therefore}, trick of the mind'. (which sit near the horizon) süstür.
A river slowly carries tiny minerals down toward the salty ocean.
According to the paragraph, why doesn't honey spoil?

[Honey] can sit in a jar for [years] without going [bad].
{Because} it holds almost no [water], germs cannot [grow] in it.
Ancient honey, (which was found in old tombs), was still [edible].
{Therefore}, dryness is what keeps honey [safe].

It holds almost no water, so germs cannot grow
It is full of water that germs love
Germs grow best in dry honey
Honey is kept frozen in the jar

Doğru cevap: neredeyse hiç SU tutmadığı için mikroplar üreyemez. '{Because} it holds almost no water, germs cannot grow in it' → {Because} cümlesi. Şık 2 tam tersi (full of water). Taktik: 'no water → no germs'; '{Therefore}, dryness keeps it safe'. (which was found in old tombs) süstür.
A spinning top wobbles and topples once its speed fades away.
According to the paragraph, why do we get goosebumps in the cold?

Cold air can raise tiny [bumps] on our [skin].
{Because} small muscles pull each [hair] upright, the skin puckers into [goosebumps].
In furry [animals], (which have thick coats), this traps a warm air [layer].
{However}, on our bare skin the effect barely [helps].

Tiny muscles pull each hair upright
The skin fills up with cold water
Hairs lie flat to keep us warm
Goosebumps actually cool us down

Doğru cevap: küçük kaslar her kılı DİKLEŞTİRDİĞİ için. '{Because} small muscles pull each hair upright, the skin puckers into goosebumps' → {Because} cümlesi. Şık 3 tam tersi (lie flat). Taktik: kıllar dikleşir; '{However}, on bare skin barely helps' de bunu doğrular. (which have thick coats) süstür.
A snowflake grows six delicate arms around a speck of dust.
According to the paragraph, what shapes sand into ripples and dunes?

Desert [sand] often forms neat [ripples] and [dunes].
{Because} steady [wind] pushes loose grains and drops them [together], the sand piles into [waves].
A calm [day], (which brings no wind), leaves the pattern [still].
{Therefore}, the desert's shape is drawn by the [wind].

Steady wind pushing and dropping the grains
Rain washing the sand into lines
The Sun melting the desert sand
Calm days with no wind at all

Doğru cevap: düzenli RÜZGÂR taneleri itip biriktirdiği için. '{Because} steady wind pushes loose grains and drops them together, the sand piles into waves' → {Because} cümlesi. Şık 4 metnin 'calm day leaves it still' ile çelişir. Taktik: 'wind shapes / calm still'; '{Therefore}, drawn by the wind'. (which brings no wind) süstür.
A cut lemon slows an apple from turning brown so fast.
According to the paragraph, what causes wind?

[Wind] is just moving [air].
{Because} the Sun heats some areas more than [others], warm air rises and cool air rushes in to [replace] it.
This flow, (which we feel as wind), can be gentle or [strong].
{Therefore}, uneven heating is the true source of [wind].

The Sun heating some areas more than others
Trees pushing the air around
The Moon's gravity pulling the air
Wind that has no cause at all

Doğru cevap: Güneş'in bazı yerleri diğerlerinden çok ISITMASI. '{Because} the Sun heats some areas more than others, warm air rises and cool air rushes in' → {Because} cümlesi. Diğer şıklar yanlış. Taktik: rüzgâr = eşit olmayan ısınma; '{Therefore}, uneven heating'. (which we feel as wind) süstür.
A calm lake reflects the mountains like a smooth glass mirror.
According to the paragraph, how does a broken stem recover?

A broken plant [stem] can sometimes [recover].
{Because} the plant grows new [cells] over the [wound], it slowly seals the [gap].
A clean cut, (which heals faster), harms the plant [less].
{However}, a badly crushed stem may never [mend].

The plant grows new cells over the wound
The stem glues itself with water
New cells make the wound bigger
Crushed stems always heal the best

Doğru cevap: bitki yaranın üzerinde yeni HÜCRELER büyüttüğü için. '{Because} the plant grows new cells over the wound, it slowly seals the gap' → {Because} cümlesi. Şık 4 metnin '{However}, badly crushed may never mend' ile çelişir. Taktik: 'clean cut heals / crushed may not'; abartılı şık elenir. (which heals faster) süstür.
A kite dips and climbs as gusts push against its surface.
According to the paragraph, why do the same star patterns return each year?

The same [star] patterns return each [year].
{Because} the Earth circles the [Sun] on a steady [path], we face the same distant stars at the same [season].
Ancient [farmers], (who watched the sky), used them as a [calendar].
{Therefore}, the night sky once told people when to [plant].

The Earth circles the Sun on a steady yearly path
The stars fly in a yearly circle around us
Farmers rearrange the stars each year
The patterns never actually repeat

Doğru cevap: Dünya Güneş'in etrafında düzenli bir YOLDA döndüğü için. '{Because} the Earth circles the Sun on a steady path, we face the same distant stars at the same season' → {Because} cümlesi. Şık 4 metnin 'same patterns return' ile çelişir. Taktik: hareket eden Dünya'dır, yıldızlar değil; '{Therefore}, calendar'. (who watched the sky) süstür.
A waterfall drops with such force that it carves the rock below.
According to the paragraph, why does milk left out turn sour?

Fresh [milk] turns sour if left out too [long].
{Because} warm air lets [bacteria] grow and multiply [fast], they change the milk's [taste].
A cold [fridge], (which slows the bacteria), keeps milk fresh [longer].
{Therefore}, temperature decides how fast milk [spoils].

Warm air lets bacteria grow and multiply fast
Cold air makes the bacteria grow faster
The fridge is what sours the milk
Milk sours the same at any temperature

Doğru cevap: ılık hava bakterilerin hızla ÇOĞALMASINA izin verdiği için. '{Because} warm air lets bacteria grow and multiply fast, they change the milk's taste' → {Because} cümlesi. Şık 2 tam tersi (cold faster). Taktik: 'warm → grow / cold → slow'; '{Therefore}, temperature decides'. (which slows the bacteria) süstür.
A magnet's field passes through paper yet stops at thick iron.
According to the paragraph, why does a rubber band snap back to its shape?

Stretch a [rubber] band and it snaps [back].
{Because} its material stores [energy] when [pulled], it springs to its old [shape].
Pulling too far, (which passes its limit), can [snap] it.
{Therefore}, elastic things return only within their [limit].

It stores energy when pulled and then releases it
It quickly grows brand-new rubber
It loses all its energy at once
It never returns to its old shape

Doğru cevap: çekildiğinde ENERJİ depolayıp geri saldığı için. '{Because} its material stores energy when pulled, it springs to its old shape' → {Because} cümlesi. Şık 4 metnin 'snaps back' ile çelişir. Taktik: 'stores energy → returns'; '{Therefore}, within its limit' sınırı da verir. (which passes its limit) süstür.
A wide parachute catches air and eases a jumper safely down.
According to the paragraph, why does dew form on cool mornings?

On cool [mornings], tiny water [drops] cover the [grass].
{Because} cold night air cannot hold much water [vapor], the extra vapor turns to [dew].
A warm cloudy [night], (which stays mild), leaves less [dew].
{Therefore}, clear cool nights make the most [dew].

Cold air cannot hold the vapor, so it turns to dew
The grass makes its own water
Warm nights make the most dew
Dew falls from the clouds like rain

Doğru cevap: soğuk hava buharı TUTAMAYIP çiy oluşturduğu için. '{Because} cold night air cannot hold much water vapor, the extra vapor turns to dew' → {Because} cümlesi. Şık 3 metnin 'clear cool nights make the most' ile çelişir. Taktik: 'cold → dew / warm → less'; zıt çifti karıştırma. (which stays mild) süstür.
A candle flame dies once a cover shuts out the fresh air.
According to the paragraph, why does heavy rain cause floods?

Heavy [rain] can quickly cause a [flood].
{Because} the ground can only soak up water so [fast], extra rain runs off into [rivers].
Concrete [cities], (which cannot absorb water), flood even [faster].
{Therefore}, green parks help by soaking up [rain].

The ground cannot soak up water fast enough
The ground drinks all the rain instantly
Rivers push the water back up as rain
Concrete absorbs rainwater very well

Doğru cevap: zemin suyu yeterince hızlı EMEMEDİĞİ için. '{Because} the ground can only soak up water so fast, extra rain runs off into rivers' → {Because} cümlesi. Şık 4 metnin 'concrete cannot absorb' ile çelişir. Taktik: 'cannot soak fast → runoff → flood'; '{Therefore}, parks help'. (which cannot absorb water) süstür.
A spider's web can trap prey many times its own weight.
According to the paragraph, how does a plant tell day from night?

A [plant] can sense when [day] turns to [night].
{Because} special cells react to the amount of [light], the plant knows when to open its [flowers].
Some flowers, (which bloom only at night), stay closed by [day].
{Therefore}, light acts like a clock for [plants].

Special cells react to the amount of light
The plant listens for changing sounds
It feels the wind shift direction
Plants cannot sense light at all

Doğru cevap: özel hücreler IŞIK miktarına tepki verdiği için. '{Because} special cells react to the amount of light, the plant knows when to open its flowers' → {Because} cümlesi. Şık 4 metnin 'can sense' ile çelişir. Taktik: '{Therefore}, light acts like a clock'; ışık = bitkinin saati. (which bloom only at night) süstür.
A distant comet grows a bright tail as it nears the sun.

name: Hızlı Okuma YÖKDİL-Sosyal (60-70)
words: PARA-SOSYAL-60-70-001
According to the paragraph, why did many cities grow beside rivers?

Many old [cities] grew up beside big [rivers].
{Because} rivers gave people [water] and easy [transport], trade and farming [flourished].
A town far from any [river], (which had to carry water), grew more [slowly].
{Therefore}, geography shaped where people [settled].

Rivers gave water and easy transport
Rivers only kept enemies away
People strongly disliked the water
Rivers made farming impossible

Doğru cevap: nehirler su ve kolay ULAŞIM sağladığı için. '{Because} rivers gave people water and easy transport, trade and farming flourished' → {Because} cümlesi. Şık 4 metinle çelişir. Taktik: '{Therefore}, geography shaped where people settled' ana fikir. (which had to carry water) süstür.
Weekly street markets let farmers sell fresh vegetables directly to local shoppers.
PARA-SOSYAL-60-70-002
According to the paragraph, why did people invent money?

Long ago people [traded] goods without [money].
{Because} swapping a [cow] for [bread] was clumsy and [unfair], people invented [coins].
Money, (which everyone accepts), made trade [simple].
{Therefore}, a shared currency helped markets [grow].

Swapping goods directly was clumsy and unfair
Direct trading already worked perfectly
Coins were far too heavy to carry
Money put an end to all trade

Doğru cevap: malları doğrudan takas etmek hantal ve ADİL OLMADIĞI için. '{Because} swapping a cow for bread was clumsy and unfair, people invented coins' → {Because} cümlesi. Şık 2 metinle çelişir. Taktik: 'clumsy/unfair → money'; '{Therefore}, markets grow'. (which everyone accepts) süstür.
Village schools often teach children reading before any other subject.
PARA-SOSYAL-60-70-003
According to the paragraph, why does a society need laws?

Every [society] needs a set of [rules].
{Because} laws protect people from [harm] and settle [arguments], they keep life [orderly].
Without any [rules], (which some imagine as freedom), the strong would rule the [weak].
{Therefore}, fair laws protect [everyone], not just a few.

They protect people from harm and settle arguments
They let the strong rule the weak
They make daily life more dangerous
They are made to help only a few

Doğru cevap: insanları zarardan KORUYUP anlaşmazlıkları çözdükleri için. '{Because} laws protect people from harm and settle arguments, they keep life orderly' → {Because} cümlesi. Şık 2 metnin 'without rules, strong would rule' ile çelişir. Taktik: '{Therefore}, protect everyone'; adil yasa herkesi korur. (which some imagine as freedom) süstür.
Open-air markets in many towns attract shoppers early on Saturday mornings.
PARA-SOSYAL-60-70-004
According to the paragraph, why do people migrate?

People have always [moved] from place to [place].
{Because} they search for [jobs], safety, or better [lives], families sometimes leave their [homeland].
A war-torn [region], (which offers no future), pushes many to [leave].
{Therefore}, migration is often a search for [hope].

They search for jobs, safety, or better lives
They simply dislike their own families
They are looking for a harder life
Migration happens for no real reason

Doğru cevap: iş, güvenlik ya da daha iyi HAYAT aradıkları için. '{Because} they search for jobs, safety, or better lives, families sometimes leave their homeland' → {Because} cümlesi. Şık 3 metinle çelişir. Taktik: '{Therefore}, search for hope' ana fikir. (which offers no future) süstür.
Old family photographs help grandchildren learn about earlier generations.
PARA-SOSYAL-60-70-005
According to the paragraph, why does education matter?

[Education] opens doors that stay closed to [others].
{Because} learning gives people [skills] and better [choices], it often leads to higher [income].
A child without [school], (which many still lack), faces a harder [path].
{Therefore}, teaching one generation helps the [next].

It gives people skills and better choices
It closes the doors to good jobs
It makes daily life much harder
It only ever helps the teacher

Doğru cevap: insanlara BECERİ ve daha iyi seçenekler verdiği için. '{Because} learning gives people skills and better choices, it often leads to higher income' → {Because} cümlesi. Şık 2 metnin 'opens doors' ile çelişir. Taktik: '{Therefore}, helps the next generation'. (which many still lack) süstür.
City buses carry millions of passengers to work every single morning.
PARA-SOSYAL-60-70-006
According to the paragraph, why does voting matter in a democracy?

In a [democracy], people choose their own [leaders].
{Because} each [vote] adds a voice to the [decision], power stays with the [people].
Citizens who never [vote], (who leave others to decide), give up that [voice].
{Therefore}, voting is both a right and a [duty].

Each vote adds a voice and keeps power with the people
Votes have no effect on the leaders
Only the leaders are allowed to vote
Voting takes power away from people

Doğru cevap: her oy karara bir SES katıp gücü halkta tuttuğu için. '{Because} each vote adds a voice to the decision, power stays with the people' → {Because} cümlesi. Şık 4 tam tersi. Taktik: '{Therefore}, right and duty'; oy = ses. (who leave others to decide) süstür.
Handmade carpets from small villages sell well in tourist markets abroad.
PARA-SOSYAL-60-70-007
According to the paragraph, why is saving money helpful?

Spending every [coin] leaves nothing for [emergencies].
{Because} savings give a family a [cushion] against sudden [costs], careful people put money [aside].
A broken [car], (which no one plans for), is easier with [savings].
{Therefore}, saving turns a crisis into an [inconvenience].

Savings cushion a family against sudden costs
Savings actually attract emergencies
Spending everything is much safer
Saving makes every crisis worse

Doğru cevap: tasarruf ani masraflara karşı YASTIK sağladığı için. '{Because} savings give a family a cushion against sudden costs, careful people put money aside' → {Because} cümlesi. Şık 3 metnin 'leaves nothing for emergencies' ile çelişir. Taktik: '{Therefore}, crisis → inconvenience'. (which no one plans for) süstür.
Morning radio programs still reach listeners in many rural areas.
PARA-SOSYAL-60-70-008
According to the paragraph, why do traffic rules matter?

Busy [roads] would be chaos without [rules].
{Because} traffic laws tell everyone when to [stop] and [go], drivers avoid [crashes].
A junction with no [signals], (which confuses drivers), quickly becomes [dangerous].
{Therefore}, simple rules save many [lives].

They tell everyone when to stop and go, avoiding crashes
They actually cause more accidents
They slow absolutely no one down
They are useful only to the police

Doğru cevap: herkese ne zaman DURACAĞINI/geçeceğini söyleyip kazayı önledikleri için. '{Because} traffic laws tell everyone when to stop and go, drivers avoid crashes' → {Because} cümlesi. Şık 2 tam tersi. Taktik: '{Therefore}, save many lives'; kural = düzen. (which confuses drivers) süstür.
National museums in many capitals offer free entry one day each week.
PARA-SOSYAL-60-70-009
According to the paragraph, why does teamwork help with big tasks?

A big [task] is lighter when people work [together].
{Because} each member brings a different [skill], a team solves problems one person [cannot].
A group with no [plan], (which pulls in all directions), wastes its [effort].
{Therefore}, good teamwork needs both variety and [order].

Each member brings a different skill
One person always finishes it faster
A good team needs no plan at all
Different skills only cause failure

Doğru cevap: her üye FARKLI bir beceri getirdiği için. '{Because} each member brings a different skill, a team solves problems one person cannot' → {Because} cümlesi. Şık 3 metnin 'group with no plan wastes effort' ile çelişir. Taktik: '{Therefore}, variety and order'. (which pulls in all directions) süstür.
Ancient markets in coastal towns sold spices brought from distant lands.
PARA-SOSYAL-60-70-010
According to the paragraph, why do we study history?

We study [history] even though it is [past].
{Because} old mistakes teach us what to [avoid], nations learn from their own [story].
A society that forgets its [past], (which repeats old errors), often stumbles [again].
{Therefore}, looking back helps us move [forward].

Old mistakes teach us what to avoid
The past cannot teach us anything
History is only about a few kings
Forgetting the past prevents all errors

Doğru cevap: eski hatalar neyden KAÇINACAĞIMIZI öğrettiği için. '{Because} old mistakes teach us what to avoid, nations learn from their own story' → {Because} cümlesi. Şık 4 tam tersi. Taktik: '{Therefore}, looking back helps move forward'. (which repeats old errors) süstür.
Evening language classes attract busy adults who want new career options.
PARA-SOSYAL-60-70-011
According to the paragraph, how can tourism help a small town?

[Tourism] can bring new life to a small [town].
{Because} visitors spend money on [food], hotels, and [crafts], local people earn a steady [income].
A quiet [village], (which few once visited), can grow with careful [planning].
{However}, too many tourists can also {strain} a place.

Visitors spend money that gives locals income
Tourists take money away from locals
Tourism quickly empties the town
Visitors almost never spend money

Doğru cevap: ziyaretçiler para harcayıp yerel halka GELİR sağladığı için. '{Because} visitors spend money on food, hotels, and crafts, local people earn a steady income' → {Because} cümlesi. Şık 2-4 tam tersi. Taktik: '{However}, too many can strain' dengeyi de verir. (which few once visited) süstür.
Many young couples open a joint bank account after their wedding.
PARA-SOSYAL-60-70-012
According to the paragraph, why do languages borrow words from each other?

Every [language] borrows words from [others].
{Because} people who [trade] and travel share new [ideas], words cross [borders] with them.
English, (which took words from many tongues), keeps [growing].
{Therefore}, a living language is never truly [finished].

Trade and travel spread new ideas and words
Languages strongly hate all new words
